title: Loading Geometry of Distributed-Lag Fixed-Effect Coefficients under Calendar-Varying Dynamic Effects
banked_reason: D0.5 upheld kernel_substituted: sound exact loading-body/CAD results remain, but the promised cross-fitted either-nuisance inference is absent and cannot be added under unchanged assumptions.
gap_reasons: The proposal current full-path augmented cross-fitted estimator with either-nuisance correctness and inference is absent; this known-propensity triangular-array approximation is a different, weaker deliverable.

The note proves exact FWL loading, support-rank geometry, published coefficient approximation, and finite-instance CAD/QE, but lacks the promised full-path doubly robust estimator, limit distribution, variance estimator, empirical application, and support-uniform ordered chamber law.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the exact arbitrary-support FWL loading tensor, absorbing-support rank geometry, a published-class coefficient approximation with a matching rate obstruction, and exact finite-instance loading-body membership, closest-loading, separation, and bounded-contamination certification through CAD/QE. The original field-tier package nevertheless collapsed because it also promised full-path cross-fitted inference under either nuisance branch; the unchanged assumptions do not provide the moment, clipping, nuisance-rate, covariance, or branch-specific regularity needed for that result. A future retry should reuse the discharged loading-body graph and add an explicit inference model rather than re-derive the algebra.
tldr: For any finite binary-path support, the paper identifies the reshaped distributed-lag fixed-effect coefficient as an exact linear functional of calendar-specific current and carryover effects and gives support-only rank and exact forward diagnostics. On the full-rank probability-floor domain, the complete loading image is a compact semialgebraic body. A terminating exact real-algebraic procedure decides target membership and returns either an algebraic feasible law or an attained closest loading, a metric-separation certificate, and exact worst-case contamination over coordinatewise bounded effects; generic cylindrical algebraic decomposition is potentially doubly exponential. The separate published unit-indexed layer retains the tensor approximation rate \(O_P(n^{-q/2})\), with a block witness showing that no uniformly faster coefficient rate follows from its stated conditions. The remaining open problem is a support-uniform ordered/combinatorial description of chamber counts, signs, incidences, and simultaneous off-diagonal-zero strata, not finite-instance decidability.
gap: Published RIPW theory states consistency of dynamic coefficients under effects that are homogeneous over calendar time and explicitly leaves the time-varying DATE equation beyond scope. Conventional event-study decompositions retain cohort and horizon cells but do not study counterfactual assignment-law reshaping with finite-memory lag regressors.
fill: The project derives that tensor in pair-mass and Green-kernel coordinates, certifies its exact computation, proves its strict reduction to the homogeneous theorem, and isolates the sign frontier as the open structural problem.
